obs: National Labor Relations Board v. Waterman Steamship Corp.
"The findings of the Board as to the facts, if supported by evidence, shall be conclusive."
National Labor Relations Board v. Link-Belt Co.
"Sec. 10 (e) provides that the 'findings of the Board as to the facts, if supported by evidence, shall be conclusive.'"
Federal Power Commission v. Natural Gas Pipeline Co.
"19(b) states that the finding of the Commission as to the facts, if supported by substantial evidence, shall be conclusive."
National Labor Relations Board v. Erie Resistor Corp.
"where Congress has in the statute given the Board a question to answer, .the courts will give respect to that answer."
Lindahl v. Office of Personnel Management

"If he is authorized to determine questions of fact his decision must be accepted unless he exceeds his authority by making a determination which is arbitrary or capricious or unsupported by evidence ... , or by failing to follow a procedure which satisfies elementary standards of fairness and reasonableness essential to the due conduct of the proceeding which Congress has authorized."
